ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

8. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.

   D. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

14. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Compilation and standardisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
